caption: The drawing features a single wooden object that appears to be a stirrup, prominently centered and rendered in brown tones that show the grain and texture of wood. The object has a wide, almost triangular base with rounded edges that tapers slightly upward, curving to form a handle-like arch at the top, which is cylindrical and connects the two sides. On one side, a circular indentation or button is visible. The base and interior edges display markings or grooves. Surrounding the main colored illustration, there are two line drawings: one in the upper left corner showing a top-down view of the object with section lines, and one in the upper right corner showing a simplified outline of the object's shape with a small circular detail near the top. The main drawing and both line drawings are enclosed within their own rectangular borders, all set against a plain, off-white background. The words "Exact Size" are written at the lower left and there is a signature, "Manuel G. Phrgan" or similar, at the lower right. The line drawings are labeled "¼ to 1" in small writing at the bottom of each.
title: Saddle Stirrup
